entries.title: Isaiah 43:1
segments: ¶But now, thus says the LORD, who created you, O Jacob, And He who formed you, O Israel: "Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called [you] by your name; You [are] Mine.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:2
segments: When you pass through the waters, I [will be] with you; And through the rivers, they shall not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned, Nor shall the flame scorch you.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:3
segments: For I [am] the LORD your God, The Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I gave Egypt for your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:4
segments: Since you were precious in My sight, You have been honored, And I have loved you; Therefore I will give men for you, And people for your life.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:5
segments: Fear not, for I [am] with you; I will bring your descendants from the east, And gather you from the west;

entries.title: Isaiah 43:6
segments: I will say to the north, 'Give them up!' And to the south, 'Do not keep them back!' Bring My sons from afar, And My daughters from the ends of the earth-

entries.title: Isaiah 43:7
segments: Everyone who is called by My name, Whom I have created for My glory; I have formed him, yes, I have made him."

entries.title: Isaiah 43:8
segments: ¶Bring out the blind people who have eyes, And the deaf who have ears.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:9
segments: Let all the nations be gathered together, And let the people be assembled. Who among them can declare this, And show us former things? Let them bring out their witnesses, that they may be justified; Or let them hear and say, "[It is] truth."

entries.title: Isaiah 43:10
segments: "You [are] My witnesses," says the LORD, "And My servant whom I have chosen, That you may know and believe Me, And understand that I [am] He. Before Me there was no God formed, Nor shall there be after Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:11
segments: I, [even] I, [am] the LORD, And besides Me [there is] no savior.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:12
segments: I have declared and saved, I have proclaimed, And [there was] no foreign [god] among you; Therefore you [are] My witnesses," Says the LORD, "that I [am] God.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:13
segments: Indeed before the day [was], I [am] He; And [there is] no one who can deliver out of My hand; I work, and who will reverse it?"

entries.title: Isaiah 43:14
segments: ¶Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, The Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon, And bring them all down as fugitives-The Chaldeans, who rejoice in their ships.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:15
segments: I [am] the LORD, your Holy One, The Creator of Israel, your King."

entries.title: Isaiah 43:16
segments: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea And a path through the mighty waters,

entries.title: Isaiah 43:17
segments: Who brings forth the chariot and horse, The army and the power (They shall lie down together, they shall not rise; They are extinguished, they are quenched like a wick):

entries.title: Isaiah 43:18
segments: "Do not remember the former things, Nor consider the things of old.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:19
segments: Behold, I will do a new thing, Now it shall spring forth; Shall you not know it? I will even make a road in the wilderness [And] rivers in the desert.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:20
segments: The beast of the field will honor Me, The jackals and the ostriches, Because I give waters in the wilderness [And] rivers in the desert, To give drink to My people, My chosen.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:21
segments: This people I have formed for Myself; They shall declare My praise.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:22
segments: ¶"But you have not called upon Me, O Jacob; And you have been weary of Me, O Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:23
segments: You have not brought Me the sheep for your burnt offerings, Nor have you honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with grain offerings, Nor wearied you with incense.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:24
segments: You have bought Me no sweet cane with money, Nor have you satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices; But you have burdened Me with your sins, You have wearied Me with your iniquities.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:25
segments: "I, [even] I, [am] He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake; And I will not remember your sins.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:26
segments: Put Me in remembrance; Let us contend together; State your [case], that you may be acquitted.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:27
segments: Your first father sinned, And your mediators have transgressed against Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 43:28
segments: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; I will give Jacob to the curse, And Israel to reproaches.
